description: This file defines the Subscription controller in the Opencart platform, handling user subscription listing, details, cancellation, history, and associated orders within the account module.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing user subscriptions, including listing, viewing details, cancelation, order history, and related actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of subscriptions for the logged-in user, with pagination and status information.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific subscription, including addresses, products, and related order information.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a subscription through AJAX, returning JSON success or error messages.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of status changes or comments related to a subscription.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Internal method to fetch and paginate subscription history entries.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Displays associated orders for a subscription.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve and paginate orders related to a subscription.
